research_attempts.query_text: George Thornton; NARA OSS index and public Archives context; CIA Reading Room or equivalent official-source check; exact-name and meaningful variants; OSS and military clues; employer and occupation 1940; obituary, institutional, newspaper, directory, Library of Congress and archival searches; Box 776; protected identifiers used privately only when defensible
research_attempts.rejection_reasons: Unbridged namesakes, search snippets, unsourced genealogy, people-finder pages, modern records, postwar-only leads and sources without an OSS, protected-identifier or Box-file bridge were not assigned. Spelling variants were search aliases only. Short or differing protected numbers were not bridged by name alone.
research_attempts.research_notes: An accepted protected-identifier Army bridge supports identity and dated student status at Army entry on 1942-12-10, without naming a school or employer. Exact-name OSS, employer, occupation, obituary, institutional, newspaper, official-domain, CIA Reading Room-equivalent and Library of Congress searches were checked as applicable. The index page, Army technical documentation and occupation-code pages were inspected directly.
